description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelCloseButton class, a PHP class that extends SugarWidgetField. It is responsible for rendering a 'close' button in a subpanel of the SuiteCRM interface, with logic to determine the button's behavior based on the module and layout definition.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelCloseButton
classes.description: A class that renders a close button for subpanels in SuiteCRM, enabling closing of activities with context-specific behavior.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML for the close button in a subpanel, with onclick behavior based on module and layout information.
